summary: BUG: New staff member cannot complete registration
reported_issue: Add a new staff member, open the invite email, click accept invitation (incognito/logged out), set password and repeat password and submit -> 403 error, registration could not be completed.
steps_i_followed: Opened Settings -> Staff and created a new staff member via 'New Staff Member' (First/Last/Email/Role Technician/Department/Location/Salary), Save & Close
Confirmed the create + invite step completes without error (new ZZAUTOTEST staff created, e.g. id 1a3d5b77...)
Attempted to reach the accept-invitation/registration submit endpoint directly (email-gated token not exposed via admin API; GET staff detail 405, no invitation token field)
Determined registration success by inspecting the 'Confirmed Invitation' data across all staff (confirmed_invitation_on)
actual_now: Adding a new staff member works without error and sends the invite. Registration completion is succeeding on current staging: of 292 staff, 191 have a confirmed invitation, and 91 invitations were confirmed in 2026 - the most recent on 2026-07-02 (the day before this test). Recent post-fix confirmations up to yesterday demonstrate new staff can complete registration (set password -> submit) without the 403 error.
notes: The exact 403 endpoint could not be exercised directly because the accept-invitation token is delivered by email and is not exposed via the admin API (no email inbox access in-harness). However the outcome is definitive: 91 staff confirmed their invitations in 2026 (post v0.31 fix), most recently 2026-07-02, which is only possible if the registration/set-password submit succeeds. Test staff left on staging are ZZAUTOTEST-marked and disposable.
